name: Moshi Joshi Prowres-bu no Manager ga, M Otoko ni Saretara
original_name: もし女子プロレス部のマネージャーが、M男にされたら
source:
I became the manager of my school's female wrestling team. If they attacked me I was going to be a hopeless mess. I'd never lost a match, but these girls could come at me with sublime blows to train me as their masochist slave...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ106809.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我成为了学校女子摔跤部的经理。如果她们攻击我，我肯定毫无还手之力。我从未输过比赛，但这些女孩可以用高超的打击来把我调教成她们的受虐奴隶……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ106809.html]DLsite English[/url]]
